name: Hausmannsgate-aksen
desc: Gateakse med veggflater, plakater og DIY-preg rundt Hausmannskvartalet.
popupDesc:
Langs Hausmannsgate og sidegatene ligger et byrom der gatekunst, plakater, politiske stensiler og midlertidige uttrykk har vært synlige over lang tid. Nærheten til selvorganiserte kulturmiljøer gjør at visuelle spor ofte fungerer som kommunikasjon mellom scener, publikum og aktivister.

I subkulturell sammenheng er aksen viktig fordi den viser hvordan urbane uttrykk oppstår i friksjon mellom kulturdrift, byutvikling og daglig bruk av gata. Her leses byen gjennom lag på lag av midlertidige markeringer.

coordChangeReason: The unsupported editorial proxy is moved approximately 49.3 metres to the deterministic half-length point of the named 46.2-metre Hausmanns gate segment that runs along the Hauskvartalet frontage controlled by addresses 34, 40 and 42. The radius is reduced from 240 to 100 metres so the record represents the finite street axis rather than a broad undefined neighbourhood environment.
coordNote: OpenStreetMap way 129061331 is a named Hausmanns gate road segment running directly along the Hauskvartalet frontage from the Hausmania/Hausmanns gate 34 end toward Hausmanns gate 40 and 42. Kartverket independently identifies Hausmanns gate as active place-name object 995873 and returns exact address points for 34, 40 and 42 on the same frontage. Oslo kommune describes Hausmania and Hausmannsgate 40/42 as core elements of Hauskvartalet. The applied coordinate is the deterministic half-length point of the 46.2-metre OSM street segment. This route record is deliberately distinct from the existing `hausmania` building canonical and the separate `brenneriveien_ingens_gate` area canonical. Changing posters, stencils and wall surfaces remain subculture content evidence rather than coordinate sources. The 100-metre gameplay radius is not a property, quarter, road, construction or access boundary.

accessContext.publicAccess: The canonical geometry follows the public street axis. Adjacent buildings, courtyards, construction sites, cultural venues and residential properties have their own access conditions.
limitations: Use ordinary public sidewalks and street space; do not enter courtyards, construction areas, residences or cultural premises without normal public access or permission.
Temporary posters, graffiti, stencils and facade treatments can change independently of the stable street geometry.
The 100-metre gameplay radius is not the legal extent of Hauskvartalet, a property boundary, road closure, construction zone or access guarantee.
